# Source: The Hanging of Judas

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** The Hanging of Judas
- **Artist / culture:** Alsatian or Southern German
- **Date:** c. 1520
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** stained glass/leaded glass
- **Department:** Applied Arts of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 65795
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/65795
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/9ffb5b78-7db0-864e-c0c1-d54a55d706e4/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Stained Glass

## Extracted source palette

`#E8E8E8, #686858, #383828, #181818, #584838, #988868, #D8D8C8, #A8A898`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#0C0C0C`
- `surface`: `#282828`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#988868`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#E8E8E8`
- `surface_variant`: `#282828`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#4E4E4E`
- `error`: `#988868`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `20dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `18.4:1`, surface `13.86:1`
- Variant contrast: `13.86:1`
- Control contrast: `5.64:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
